text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Alright.
First, let's start by checking my dance form—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~, insane!
Verxina-chan, your body is crazy flexible~!!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Perhaps it is thanks to the stretches I do every morning.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That's Jordan-san and Verxina-san.
...Are they doing voluntary training together?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, remember that move you showed me the other day?
You know, that... backflip!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Doing that in a dance routine would totally hype up the crowd~.
I wanna try doing it too.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, care to give it a try?
I would be more than happy to instruct you as best I can.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, Jordan-san.
...Are you planning on attempting a backflip now?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Reckless practice substantially raises the risk of injury.
If you do not mind, allow me to assist as your spotter.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real!? That helps a ton~.
As expected of Flash-san!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this much is my pleasure. Once we understand the mechanics, we can properly structure the task management—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Picture yourself turning into a fidget spinner!
We'll talk after that!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there she is! ...Ah, right.
Come to think of it, you could do backflips too, couldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmph, takes me back... Back in the day, I had a backflip showdown against a rabbit for the title of world's strongest...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (...People just naturally gather around her, don't they...?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Jordan-san, you're practicing backflips?
In that case, I recommend facing southwest!
It'll balance your qi and might keep you from getting hurt♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!?
Shoot, then we've totally gotta do that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Also, anyone else wanna join in~?
Let's all do backflips together!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh~ sounds fun! Count me in~.
—Um, actually, I've been interested too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: W-Wait... aren't way too many people gathering here...!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Is this the unity of the JRA Tracen Academy...?
Kuh, as a Funabashi horse girl, I must brace myself...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy. How 'bout you, Furioso-san?
Wanna flip with us?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Me, as well...? No, I must decline.
When it comes to backflips, I am already proficient.
There is no need for me to practice at this point.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
Hey hey, how do you pull that off?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...It is not something easily explained in a single sentence. It was merely the result of steady, diligent practice with my friends back in Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, you could do backflips even before coming here!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I forget exactly when it was, but we all practiced together so everyone could do it—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ALL your Funabashi friends can do it!?
Isn't that crazy awesome!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: W-Well... my friends in Funabashi are all exceptionally capable and highly motivated, so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... A whole squad of backflip elites...
Funabashi is on a whole 'nother level...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, show us, won't ya!?
The Funabashi-style backflip!!
I wanna see some next-level moves~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing unusually lively voices from the dance studio, I peeked inside to see...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Here I go—Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: A roundoff into a back handspring, and then a back tuck...! Fufu, quite impressive, Furioso-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Insane! That was god-tier just now!?
Hey hey, how did you even do that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching the horse girls gather together to attempt backflips, I could only tilt my head in bewilderment.
